t: Local-First Git: A Private Playground for Jupyter and AI Workflows
s: This article details a setup for private, version-controlled AI/Jupyter development using nested Git repositories, shared Python environments, and `nbstripout` for clean notebook history, enabling local-first redundancy without cloud reliance.
sub: Nested Git repositories for isolated experimental code
Using `nbstripout` to clean Jupyter Notebook metadata
Setting up local Git remotes for redundancy
